In this writ petition, the petitioners have sought for the following reliefs.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for the respondents No.1, 2 and 5 to 7 and the learned counsel for respondents No.3 and 4 and perused the material on record.

3. It is the grievance of the petitioners that their representation dated 04.07.2016 at Annexure-D,
submitted to the respondents has not been considered so far by them nor any order has been passed on the same.
Under these circumstances, the petitioners are before this Court by wa y of the present petition.
4. Per contra, learned HCGP and the learned counsel for the respective respondents submit that if reasonable time is given, they would consider and pass necessary order on the said representation.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions, respondents are hereby directed to address the grievances of the petitioner and consider their representation dated 04.07.2016 at Annexure-D and pass appropriate order in accordance with la w, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
